narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Comparison A (Japan) -> Comparison B (Taiwan).
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously compare and contrast social norms between Japan and Taiwan regarding punctuality and work culture. It satirizes the extreme professional pressure and over-politeness in Japan when running late through exaggerated performance, contrasted with a pragmatic, almost lazy alternative from the Taiwanese perspective.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a vertical split-screen format popular on social media platforms to clearly delineate the two subjects of comparison.
